scope: M14 DJ playback and transition save focus
before: Return from cadence or transition timing disables the whole fieldset including Save, leaving BODY. Playback success also leaves BODY when its clean Save stays natively disabled.
implementation: Keep existing native-disabled fields while saving. Move Save outside each fieldset and preserve its native focusability through save/readback with aria-disabled/aria-busy and muted/progress styling.

On an eligible explicit submit, synchronously focus and nearest-reveal Save only if the visible focused document active element belongs to that exact form and no dialog/popover is open. Existing useEdit synchronous write guard remains unchanged.

Local onFocus/onBlur ownership retains clean Save after success only while it owns focus; Tab returns it to native disabled. No completion focus effect. Section unmount discards local ownership while existing SettingsEdits retains the write/draft above pages.
Definite failure retains draft and enables explicit retry; normal saved status announcements remain.

pairedDecision.Steve: Independent persistent Save outside native-disabled fieldset proposal. Initially favored always-focusable clean Save; challenge adopts focus-owned clean retention to avoid dead Tab stops. Implemented playback component; reviewed integration without blocker.
pairedDecision.Elena: Independent native-locked fields and focus-owned Save retention proposal. Implemented transition component; reviewed integration without blocker.
pairedDecision.Morgan: Selected shared converged behavior; root removes redundant form ref and pre-focus retention assignment, preserves busy Save through pending, adds scoped styling and owns native verification. No new shared abstraction.
pairedDecision.finalReview: Steve and Elena independently reviewed final source, unchanged edit owner, bundle hashes, contract trace and evidence. Both found no blocker for this slice; Steve requested explicit source-only scope for page-level detours, retained in limits.

Successful submit targets have solid visible outline and lie above player.
checks.savedFiles: Actual disposable local-state file proves cadence4 then5 and transition fadeOut2 then3, with no write on the deliberate transition failure. Playback duplicate queue/current occurrence, position12, volume0.42, shuffle=false and repeat=off remain identical; transport stays paused.

sourceTraceSupplement.text: Settings contains account/libraries, DJ playback and transitions, provider keys, shared sources, and reusable DJs. When explicitly saving General DJ playback or transition preferences, keep visible keyboard focus on Save while fields lock and readback completes. Ignore repeated save activation. Keep a failed draft editable for an explicit retry. A successful clean Save retains its current focus until the user moves on, then leaves the Tab order. Later Tab or section/page navigation wins; completing a save elsewhere must not reclaim focus. Saving or removing a provider key keeps its confirmed status authoritative over older status reads, including checks started while saving. Check only that provider again after a failed save, retain its entered draft and error while checking, and keep editing available. Keep masked key drafts, pending save/removal and failure feedback through music navigation and Settings section changes. These drafts exist only in memory. Keys apply to this app on this Mac across music accounts. Signing out or changing account identity clears entered key text and settled errors; an already-started key change can finish, and its provider remains locked until settlement. Its confirmed status applies globally, but its old-session failure must not reappear in the new account. Show this pending-write caveat in sign-out confirmation while a key change is saving. A status check never prepares text or audio. News bucket → Settings edits the chosen profile and its preparation schedule. Keep one combined draft for sources, host, mood, interests, and preparation preferences. Preserve it through music navigation and shared-management visits. Distinguish draft activation from saved running state, and offer save/discard/cancel for all fields before switching profiles. Save setup and workflow choices atomically. Gate enabled preparation on current sources, saved host, mood, and required key status; allow incomplete setup and disabling preparation without keys.
